biography.value: 6uff is a Nigerian artist and producer from Anambra State whose music blends Afro-fusion and hip-hop.
ADÉLA is a Slovak singer and songwriter based in Los Angeles. She trained in ballet at English National Ballet School before pursuing music.
Jhené Aiko is an American singer and songwriter from Los Angeles, known for her R&B recordings.
Fat Joe is an American rapper from the Bronx, New York.
Masauti is a Kenyan singer and songwriter from Mombasa who records in Swahili.
Mbilia Bel is a Congolese singer associated with rumba and soukous, known for her work with Tabu Ley Rochereau.
Fari Athman is an Afro-pop artist from Nairobi, Kenya.
DJGIDS254 is a Kenyan DJ who publishes Bongo Flava mixes under Thevibezmaster.
DJ EXRAY publishes mixes spanning Afrobeats, Bongo, dancehall, hip-hop and R&B.
Zzero Sufuri is a Kenyan musician associated with the Gengetone scene.
Nicki Minaj is a Trinidad-born rapper raised in Queens, New York, known for Pink Friday.
Rod Wave is a singer and rapper from St. Petersburg, Florida, whose music draws on soul and hip-hop.
